expected.reference_answer: You can return most items within 30 days of the delivery date. Every return needs an RMA number, which you can request on the Orders page of the account portal or from returns@northline.example.com.

expected.reference_answer: If you pay an invoice within 10 days of the invoice date, you can deduct 2% of the merchandise total. Overdue balances carry a finance charge of 1.5% per month. When an account is more than 15 days past due, it goes on credit hold and new orders do not ship until the overdue balance is paid.

Credit hold: when an account is more than 15 days past due, new orders do not ship until the overdue balance is paid. [1]
